contract.identityAlgorithm: Strict UTF-8; remove optional BOM; normalize CRLF and CR to LF; SHA-256 normalized UTF-8 bytes; tree SHA-256 over ordinal path|fileHash rows joined by LF.

researchQuestions.RQ1: Do RICE_HEAD_COMPLETION and G1_INTERIOR_SPATIAL retain frozen feasibility under corrected future-held exclusion?
researchQuestions.RQ2: How many of the historical 16881 G1 occurrences retain or change state and support?
researchQuestions.RQ3: Which temporal, identity, overlapping or other exclusions explain each difference?
researchQuestions.RQ4: Can the exact eleven historical operational supported G1 occurrence IDs be reconstructed and paired?
researchQuestions.RQ5: Does corrected G1 retain independent joint support in at least two charts and two keymodes?
researchQuestions.RQ6: What are corrected universe-C operational and operational-supported counts, distinct from placements?
researchQuestions.RQ7: Does RICE reproduce the exact historical snapshot as a regression sentinel?
researchQuestions.RQ8: What is the complete historical-state to corrected-state transition matrix?
researchQuestions.RQ9: Are two evaluations of the same loaded inputs byte-identical, RNG-free and non-mutating?

historicalCaseRule.pairing: Exact OccurrenceId only; absence in the corrected branch is INVALID; nondeterministic reconstruction is BLOCKED.

operationalUniverseC.source: CurrentGateAudit rows where CurrentOpportunity is true, mapped by AnchorId to G1 GroupId

classification.familyCriterion: Independent joint support in >=2 charts and >=2 keymodes; >=1 supported operational target; zero integrity failures and RNG calls; no behavior change; byte-identical repeat.
classification.invalid: Any contract, identity, dependency, structural equivalence, snapshot, integrity, determinism, RNG or non-interference failure.
classification.blocked: A prerequisite or exact historical eleven-case reconstruction is unavailable.
classification.feasibilityDemonstrated: Valid complete authorized evaluation where both RICE and G1 pass.
classification.limitedPark: Valid complete authorized evaluation where one or both families do not pass.

determinismRules: UTF-8 without BOM and LF outputs
No timestamps, GUIDs, machine names or absolute paths
Two runs over identical loaded input must serialize byte-identically
noInterferenceRules: Input chart fingerprint before equals fingerprint after
RICE historical and corrected summaries are identical
stopConditions: Structural drift outside AnchorTime or FutureHeldObservationIds
Historical eleven-case count, distribution or keymode mismatch
Missing publication binding, corpus adapter or explicit human authorization
